import json,collections
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
a[0]['slots']['1']='ь'
a[38]['slots']['1']='other'
a[38]['note']='The final glyph has an ascender and crossbar: printed ѣ.'
a[71]['slots']['1']='ь'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for row in a:f.write(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(items)==len(a)
for item,row in zip(items,a):
 assert item['item_id']==row['item_id']
 expected={str(x) for x in range(1,item['slots']+1)}
 assert set(row['slots'])==expected
 assert set(row['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(x in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for x in row['slots'].values())
 assert all(x in ['high','low'] for x in row['confidence'].values())
 assert row['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
 assert isinstance(row['unmarked_final_hard_signs'],list)
counts=collections.Counter(v for row in a for v in row['slots'].values())
print('Count, order, slot coverage: PASS')
print('Items:',len(a))
print('Slot calls:',dict(counts),'total',sum(counts.values()))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(row['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for row in a))
